name: topchicken
title: top chicken
blurb: enter a handle: pulls everyone they follow and everyone who follows them, scans that whole network's posts from the previous UTC day, and crowns whoever got the most likes "top chicken" for that handle — plus a runners-up "pecking order" and a shareable card. Also has a /hype path: a hype reel of every real winner @topchicken.bsky.social has ever crowned, played back with their actual winning post. @dave.9000ish.uk asked for this one; the hype reel was natalie.sh's idea.
